# Test GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1 disables direct VCS and C toolchain invocations during 'go build'.

# Default value is 0.
go env GORESTRICTEDBUILD
stdout '^0$'

# Invalid values are rejected by go env -w and go build.
! go env -w GORESTRICTEDBUILD=true
stderr 'invalid GORESTRICTEDBUILD value'

env GORESTRICTEDBUILD=invalid
! go build ./pure
stderr 'invalid GORESTRICTEDBUILD value'

# Enable restricted build mode.
env GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1
go env GORESTRICTEDBUILD
stdout '^1$'

# Pure-Go build succeeds even with CGO_ENABLED=1 in the environment
# and a fake broken CC / git in PATH.
env CGO_ENABLED=1
go build -o $WORK/pure.exe ./pure
exists $WORK/pure.exe

# -buildvcs=auto (default) is downgraded to false, so a .git directory does not invoke git.
mkdir ./puregit/.git
cp ./pure/main.go ./puregit/main.go
go build -o $WORK/puregit.exe ./puregit
exists $WORK/puregit.exe

# Explicit -buildvcs=true is rejected.
! go build -buildvcs=true -o $WORK/puregit2.exe ./puregit
stderr '-buildvcs=true is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

# Cgo files are ignored (CGO_ENABLED is forced to 0) even with CGO_ENABLED=1.
! go build ./usecgopkg
stderr 'build constraints exclude all Go files'

# Non-standard .syso files are rejected.
! go build ./usesyso
stderr '\.syso files not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

# External linking via -ldflags is rejected.
! go build -ldflags=-linkmode=external -o $WORK/ext.exe ./pure
stderr 'external linking.*not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

# Direct cmd/link invocation with GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1 also rejects external linking.
go tool compile -p main -o $WORK/main.o ./pure/main.go
! go tool link -linkmode=external -o $WORK/ext2.exe $WORK/main.o
stderr 'external linking is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

# VCS module fetches are disallowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1.
env GOPROXY=direct
env GOVCS=*:all
! go build -mod=mod ./needvcs
stderr 'VCS .* disallowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'
env GOPROXY=off

# C-dependent build flags and modes are rejected.
! go build -compiler=gccgo ./pure
stderr '-compiler=gccgo is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

! go build -asan ./pure
stderr '-asan is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

! go build -msan ./pure
stderr '-msan is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

! go build -linkshared ./pure
stderr '-linkshared is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

! go build -buildmode=c-archive ./pure
stderr '-buildmode=c-archive is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

! go build -buildmode=c-shared ./pure
stderr '-buildmode=c-shared is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

! go build -buildmode=shared ./pure
stderr '-buildmode=shared is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

! go build -buildmode=plugin ./pure
stderr '-buildmode=plugin is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

# Other subcommands (e.g. go test) are not restricted by GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1.
go test ./pure

# CGO_ENABLED=bindings works together with GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1 without a C toolchain,
# while still disallowing traditional cgo, pkg-config, .syso files, and external linking.
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOEXPERIMENT=runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
env CC=nonexistent-cc

go build -o $WORK/binding.exe ./usecgobindingpkg
exists $WORK/binding.exe

! go build ./usecgopkg
stderr 'build constraints exclude all Go files'

! go build -o $WORK/binding_pc.exe ./usecgobindingpkgconfig
stderr 'pkg-config is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

! go build -o $WORK/binding_syso.exe ./usecgobindingsyso
stderr '\.syso files not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

env GOOS=android
env GOARCH=amd64
! go build -o $WORK/android_amd64_binding.exe ./usecgobindingpkg
stderr 'requires external linking, which is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

env GOOS=aix
env GOARCH=ppc64
! go build -o $WORK/aix_ppc64_binding.exe ./usecgobindingpkg
stderr 'cgo bindings on aix/ppc64 require external linking, which is not allowed when GORESTRICTEDBUILD=1'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/restricted

go 1.26

-- pure/main.go --
package main

func main() {}

-- purepkg/p.go --
package purepkg

func F() {}

-- needvcs/main.go --
package main

import _ "vcs-test.golang.org/git/emptytest.git"

func main() {}

-- pure/main_test.go --
package main

import "testing"

func TestOK(t *testing.T) {}

-- usecgopkg/main.go --
package main

// #cgo LDFLAGS: -L.
import "C"

func main() {}

-- usecgobindingpkg/main.go --
package main

import "C"

//cgo:func puts puts libc
func puts(s *byte) int32

func main() { _ = puts }

-- usecgobindingpkgconfig/main.go --
package main

// #cgo pkg-config: nonexistent
import "C"

//cgo:func puts puts libc
func puts(s *byte) int32

func main() { _ = puts }

-- usecgobindingsyso/main.go --
package main

import "C"

//cgo:func puts puts libc
func puts(s *byte) int32

func main() { _ = puts }

-- usecgobindingsyso/dummy.syso --
not an object

-- usesyso/main.go --
package main

func main() {}

-- usesyso/dummy.syso --
not an object
